The schedule is the one I gave before. The team note (Elif in slot 1, Cara in slot 2) can't be right, because it breaks the constraints.

- Cara is before Dev, and Dev is before Ben. Ben is before Finn, and Finn is right after Elif, so Ben is before Elif.
- Hana is right after Ben, and Hana isn't Elif, so Hana is also before Elif.
- That puts Cara, Dev, Ben and Hana all ahead of Elif, so Elif can't be earlier than slot 5.
- Elif, Finn and Gus are consecutive. Ann and Ivo come after Gus, since Ivo is after Gus and Ivo is right after Ann.

This gives Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo.

I checked every constraint against this order, and all hold. Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five slots apart.
